selection_reason.summary: On hurdle debut over 2m 1f 33y. Throatlash placed twice over this course and distance over hurdles and won his first three handicap chases last season. Hurlyburly was third of 11 on hurdle debut at Hexham, 5½ lengths behind the winner. Both meet Doubly Blessed at 11 st without claims or penalties. Get Out Of My Way was withdrawn, leaving ten declared runners.
selection_reason.counterargument: Doubly Blessed won his sole Irish point by a wide margin and finished second on his Rules debut in a Kelso bumper. The point win shows jumping experience. He can win if he brings that ability to hurdles on his first start for Dan Skelton. The advance proposal described the point win as a bumper win. This was corrected against Timeform at approval.
selection_reason.why_still_oppose: Both principal rivals have demonstrated competitive form over hurdles at level weights. The favourite's point and bumper form are credible but leave his hurdle performance uncertain.
selection_reason.rival_limitations: Throatlash must transfer recent chase form back to hurdles and ended last season below his best. Hurlyburly remains a maiden and returns after a break.
selection_reason.source: The Racing API Pro and Sporting Life, with Timeform form verification
selection_reason.uncertainty: Moderate evidence. Carlisle’s 08:00 inspection was pending on publication. Value and full-stake matching unverified.
